adjudication.rationale: Verified in `addGuests.handler.ts`: `uniqueGuests` only filters out emails already present on the booking via `guest === attendee.email` (case-sensitive) and does not dedupe within the incoming `guests` array (no `indexOf`/`Set`-based uniqueness check). The server schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` in `addGuests.schema.ts` only validates `.email()` and has no uniqueness/case-normalization refinement. As a result, inputs like repeated emails or `A@x.com` vs `a@x.com` can survive `uniqueGuests` and be passed to `attendees.createMany`, potentially creating duplicate attendee rows for the same booking.
